26struct SensorDelayLineParams {
27 /* Time from input publication to output publication [ms]; delayMs + jitterMs fits in
28 * bufferMs. */
29 double delayMs = 0.0;
30
31 /* @brief Pending-history duration used to size storage at Init [ms].
32 * Choose a duration covering the maximum delay; underestimated capacity reports overflow. */
33 double bufferMs = 1000.0;
34
35 /* @brief Fallback publication rate [Hz] when the input has no positive rate estimate. */
36 double bufferAssumedFrequencyHzEstimate = 100.0;
37
38 /* Each sample is due delayMs plus its own draw in [0, jitterMs) after its input publication [ms]
39 * and publishes no earlier than the samples before it: delivery stays in order, so the extra
40 * delay is not uniform when samples arrive faster than the jitter. */
41 double jitterMs = 0.0;
42 /* The jitter's stream, drawn once per sample keyed by its capture step. */
43 SensorRandomParams random;
44
45 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::SensorDelayLineParams)
46 MOCHI_FIELD(delayMs) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("ms"));
47 MOCHI_FIELD(bufferMs) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("ms"));
48 MOCHI_FIELD(bufferAssumedFrequencyHzEstimate) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("1/s"));
49 MOCHI_FIELD(jitterMs) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("ms"));
50 MOCHI_FIELD(random);
51 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
52};

54/* @brief Time-domain delay over one fixed CPU sensor output, with optional seeded jitter that
55 * keeps the samples in order. The first input sample after a reset publishes at once and holds
56 * until delayed samples follow. Storage is sized once at Init from bufferMs and kept across
57 * resets. */
58class MOCHI_API SensorDelayLine final : public SensorBase {
59 public:
60 using Params = SensorDelayLineParams;
61

63 return "SENSOR_DELAY_LINE";
64 }
65
66 SensorDelayLine(Actor* actor, std::string_view paramArgs, superdex::Error& error);
67 SensorDelayLine(Actor* actor, Params const& params, superdex::Error& error);
68 explicit SensorDelayLine(Params const& params, superdex::Error& error);
69 ~SensorDelayLine() override;
70
71 [[nodiscard]] std::string_view GetTypeName() const override {
72 return TypeName();
73 }
74
75 [[nodiscard]] SensorStepResult Step(StepTime const& now, superdex::Error& error) override;
76 [[nodiscard]] Span<std::byte const> TryGetMetadata(std::string_view key) const override;
77
78 [[nodiscard]] Params GetParams() const {
79 return _params;
80 }
81
82 /* Apply episode parameters before graph Reset; initialized capacity is immutable. */
83 void SetParams(Params const& params, superdex::Error& error);
84
85 private:
86 struct QueuedSample {
87 int64_t captureStep = -1;
88 double captureTime = 0.0;
89 double dueTime = 0.0;
90 };
91
92 [[nodiscard]] SensorFormat InitSensor(SensorScope const& scope, superdex::Error& error) override;
93 void ResetSensor() override;
94 void Initialize(Params const& params, superdex::Error& error);
95 void Enqueue(SensorSample const& source, superdex::Error& error);
96 [[nodiscard]] bool PublishDue(StepTime const& now, superdex::Error& error);
97
98 Params _params;
99 std::size_t _elementsPerSample = 0;
100 /* Ring of samples waiting for their due time, sized at Init: _size of them from _head. */
101 DynamicArray<QueuedSample> _ring;
102 DynamicArray<float> _ringValues;
103 std::size_t _head = 0;
104 std::size_t _size = 0;
105 int64_t _lastInputPublishedStep = -1;
106};
